query:
UPDATE priceHistory ph
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    cardId,
    grade,
    AVG(jpyPrice) as avgPrice,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM priceHistory
  WHERE source = 'snkrdunk' AND productType = 'single_card' AND jpyPrice IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cardId, grade
) stats ON ph.cardId = stats.cardId AND (ph.grade = stats.grade OR (ph.grade IS NULL AND stats.grade IS NULL))
SET ph.isSuspectedBulk = CASE 
  WHEN stats.cnt >= 5 AND ph.jpyPrice > 4 * stats.avgPrice THEN 1
  ELSE 0
END
WHERE ph.source = 'snkrdunk' AND ph.productType = 'single_card' AND ph.jpyPrice IS NOT NULL;
